from.place: Proof paragraph 2, displayed finite-coefficient derived mapping-complex adjunction before R lim; through the recorded enriched localization ancestry and the complete-Segal/quasicategory comparison, the inner-horn part of the mixed box lifting argument (Joyal–Tierney Proposition 3.10 with the terminal target). title: Spines and right cancellation generate inner horns
statement:
Use small simplicial sets and standard simplices of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and inner horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in fixed universes. For $n\geq2$ let $I_n\subseteq\Delta^n$ be the simplicial subset generated by the edges $[j,j+1]$, $0\leq j<n$. Let $\mathcal A$ be a class of degreewise injective simplicial maps. Suppose it contains all isomorphisms and is closed under composition, pushouts, small coproducts, small continuous transfinite compositions, and retracts of arrows. Use colimits of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; a pushout is the colimit of a span, and a coproduct is the colimit of a discrete diagram. These colimits are computed degreewise in sets. A continuous transfinite composition is the map $Z_0\to Z_\theta$ of a diagram indexed by a small ordinal interval $[0,\theta]$ such that $Z_\beta=\operatorname{colim}_{\alpha<\beta}Z_\alpha$ at every nonzero limit ordinal $\beta\leq\theta$; all successor maps must belong to the class. An arrow retract of $g:A'\to B'$ is a map $f:A\to B$ with maps $a:A\to A'$, $b:B\to B'$, $r:A'\to A$, $s:B'\to B$ satisfying $ga=bf$, $fr=sg$, $ra=1_A$, $sb=1_B$.
Assume also right cancellation among monomorphisms: if $u:A\hookrightarrow B$ and $v:B\hookrightarrow C$ satisfy $u\in\mathcal A$ and $vu\in\mathcal A$, then $v\in\mathcal A$. If $I_n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ belongs to $\mathcal A$ for every $n\geq2$, then $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ belongs to $\mathcal A$ for every $n\geq2$, $0<i<n$.
